user.title: Connect your Govee account
user.description: Get an API key in the Govee Home app: Profile → Settings → Apply for API Key. Govee emails it to you.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to ask Govee for the lamp's state. Govee allows about 10,000 requests a day per key, so keep this at 60 seconds or more if you have several lamps.

devices.title: Choose your lamps
devices.description: Found {count} Govee lights. Lamps with more than one light are preselected.

reauth_confirm.title: Govee API key expired
reauth_confirm.description: Govee rejected the stored API key. Paste a new one.

error.invalid_auth: Govee rejected this API key. Check for missing characters, or request a new key in the Govee app.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Govee's servers. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.no_devices: This Govee account has no lights.

abort.already_configured: This Govee account is already set up.

menu_options.pick_lamp: Map a lamp's lights to segments

zones.title: Lights in {name}
zones.description: This lamp reports {count} segments, numbered 0 to {last}. Give each light a name and the segments it covers, for example `0-9` or `10-14`. Leave a row empty to skip it. To find the right split, change a light's colour from Developer tools and watch which part of the lamp changes.

error.incomplete: Give this light both a name and segments.
error.bad_segments: Use segment numbers within the lamp's range, like 0-9 or 3, 5, 7.
error.overlap: These segments are already used by another light.

abort.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Govee's servers. Try again in a moment.
abort.no_segment_lamps: None of your selected lamps has segments to map. Lamps whose second light is a separate switch are set up automatically.
